features.title: Unattended loop driver with stop guard and evaluator split
features.user_visible_behavior: `pnpm harness:loop` picks the next ready feature, creates a worktree and branch feat/F-NNN, runs a generator `claude -p` session under the caps in harness.config.json, re-checks the result deterministically, runs the fresh-context evaluator, opens a PR with gh and records the run in .harness/runs.jsonl; an opt-in Stop hook (HARNESS_STOP_GUARD=1) blocks a driver-run session from stopping in a dirty state.
verification: L1: pnpm check
manual: pnpm harness:loop --dry-run prints the worktree commands and the exact claude invocations without running them
manual: .claude/hooks/stop-guard.sh blocks with simulated Stop input when HARNESS_STOP_GUARD=1 and the tree is dirty, and allows when stop_hook_active is true or the variable is unset
evidence: 2026-09-06 manual: pnpm harness:loop --dry-run prints the worktree commands and the exact claude invocations without running them → waived via --allow-manual by eemelisurakka (commit 1ba9b9f)
